Methods for graph structure selection results

Source: R/selection.R
mcg_selection-methods.Rd

Print, summarize and plot the result of mc_graph_stepwise or mc_select_lambda. print shows the selector, the criterion, the number and list of selected edges and, for the L1 route, the selected penalty. summary adds the search trace (stepwise), the head of the penalty path (L1), and the v-structures and CPDAG when the object carries them. plot draws the network of the selected fit with mc_plot_network.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mcg_selection'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mcg_selection'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mcg_selection'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x, object

an object of class "mcg_selection".

...

for plot, further arguments passed to mc_plot_network; ignored by print and summary.

Value

print and summary return the object invisibly; plot returns invisibly the value of mc_plot_network applied to the selected fit (or the object itself when it carries no fit).

See also

mc_graph_stepwise, mc_select_lambda.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1); n <- 200; x <- rnorm(n)
y1 <- rnorm(n); y2 <- 0.6 * y1 + rnorm(n); y3 <- rnorm(n)
d <- data.frame(y1 = y1, y2 = y2, y3 = y3, x = x)
f <- mcglm_graph(list(y1 ~ x, y2 ~ x, y3 ~ x), data = d)
#> Automatic initial values selected.
sel <- mc_graph_stepwise(f)
print(sel)
#> Graph structure selection (stepwise, criterion = bic)
#> Selected edges: 1
#> Edges:
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]    1    2
summary(sel)
#> Graph structure selection (stepwise, criterion = bic)
#> Selected edges: 1
#> Edges:
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]    1    2
#> 
#> Search trace:
#>   step action edge_i edge_j criterion
#> 1    1 remove      1      3  1671.188
#> 2    2 remove      2      3  1666.173
# }
